properties.rationale: Deferred on Anthony's word, 2026-07-28, alongside the other four captured from the reflow workflow review. The requirement is accepted, not dropped: is_entry_point / is_exit_point / inputs / outputs / capability_type are declared and read by nothing, which blocks three of reflow's five functional-mode detectors (unreachable_functions, dead_end_functions, unexplained_outputs). Both honest resolutions — compute against the vocabulary, or remove it — are real work scheduled for a later increment. Sibling of req:defaults-do-not-assert, itself parked the same day.
